sara: FYI customer acme-inc reports console usage metrics lagging by ~4h, spikes missing in hourly chart. They say UI shows data only up to 03:00 but API logs have activity until 07:00. org: org_03A9. request ids: r_q8x2, r_q8x9. Can we confirm ETL/backfill status? :eyes:
omar: Thanks — can you paste a quick repro? timeframe + which dashboard?
sara: Steps I used:
1) org settings -> Usage -> Last 24h
2) group by hour
3) compare to raw /admin/usage logs for org_03A9 between 2026-03-17T00:00Z and 2026-03-17T08:00Z
Result: UI stops at 03:00, raw logs show many requests after that (example below).

sara: Example API log lines:
```
2026-03-17T05:12:21Z INFO req=r_q8x2 org=org_03A9 tokens=420 latency_ms=18
2026-03-17T05:14:03Z INFO req=r_q8x9 org=org_03A9 tokens=130 latency_ms=22
```

omar: pinging ingest team — @derek can you check the hourly ETL job and partition for 2026-03-17? Is the aggregator lagging? :thinking:
derek: saw a noisy box earlier, the analytics indexer restarted at 2026-03-17T03:35Z. There was a backlog in S3->clickhouse loader for partition 2026-03-17T04. We kicked off an emergency backfill at 2026-03-17T04:40Z. Currently processing, ETA ~45m-90m depending on IO.

ingest-bot: ETL alert: ingestion-queue-lag >= 3h for partition=2026-03-17 (detected 2026-03-17T04:05Z). retry_count=2. job_id=backfill-9f3b.

maria: added — I restarted the slow node and bumped the loader concurrency to 6. Watching memory and IO. No customer data loss expected, just delayed metrics.

sara: Thanks team. Customer asked for expected time to see metrics in UI and whether billing is affected. Can we confirm if usage will be backfilled for billing windows?
derek: Yes — backfill writes to canonical tables used by billing. We will backfill full range for 2026-03-17 partition once loader completes. Confirmed billing pipeline reads canonical table snapshots hourly; next snapshot after backfill will include the missing rows. I'll post the backfill job link: https://redwood.internal/jobs/backfill-9f3b (ETA ~1h).

natalie: Marking P2 for customer-facing updates. Sara please send a short status note to the customer: what happened, ETA, and mitigation (no billing impact expected). Use this language: "We detected a transient ETL backlog that delayed analytics ingestion for a subset of events. Our data engineering team is running a backfill; metrics should appear within ~1 hour and billing will reflect the corrected usage."
sara: Copying suggested language. I'll message them now and ask to reopen if they still see gaps after 90m.

omar: Follow-up action items:
- derek: create a postmortem entry in #postmortems if backlog recurs (assign: derek).
- infra: add stronger alerting on loader IO > 60% for >15m (action: maria).
- eng: verify dashboard cache invalidation when backfills complete (action: omar).

sara: Logged customer note and set reminder to check in 90m. Closing loop here unless something changes. :white_check_mark:
